newsitem.title: USA: Mazda looks to trim U.S. dealerships - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Mazda looks to trim U.S. dealerships - WSJ.

text.p: A week after Mazda Motor Corp announced it would cut its North American staff by 25 percent in a restructuring, the automaker is now looking to trim its U.S. dealership network, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal that Mazda is considering an overhaul of its 1,100 North American dealerships -- particularly among its weakest and smallest.
"We'll try to put more resources into larger, more capable dealers to make them even stronger," an unnamed Mazda executive told the Journal.
Mazda is 33.4 percent owned by Ford Motor Co.
